name: Suzhou Denglin Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Denglin Technology Co., Ltd. designs and develops general-purpose graphics processing units for enterprise artificial intelligence applications in China and Singapore. The company offers enterprise data center accelerator cards, including the Goldwasser I L Series for AI model inference, the Goldwasser II GS Series for inference and training workloads, and the KS Series for high-density AI server environments supporting industrial large model deployment. It also provides edge inference products, such as Goldwasser I UL/MXM Series low-power inference modules and KS Series edge inference cards for inference scenarios.
